title: US insurance giant Allstate has been suffering an outage since November 23, affecting its website and app; the company hasn't said what is causing the outage (Jean Eaglesham/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Jean Eaglesham / Wall Street Journal: US insurance giant Allstate has been suffering an outage since November 23, affecting its website and app; the company hasn't said what is causing the outage — The multiday outage has left customers struggling to reach the insurer during one of the year's busiest travel weeks
